title: Dinosaurs for Hire #1 Eternity Comics 1988 Tom Mason Bryon Carson Alex Leonine
conditionDescription: Cover bright with light creasing near the spine and corner wear; back cover lightly toned with edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Dinosaurs for Hire #1 (1988), Eternity Comics - Tom Mason, Bryon Carson and Alex Leonine. Archie, Lorenzo and Reese, the gun-toting dinosaur mercenaries, later a Sega Genesis game. $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: Ex-Mutants: The Shattered Earth Chronicles "They're Back!" ad.

Condition: cover bright with light creasing near the spine and corner wear; back cover lightly toned with edge wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
